I think its a great item, i just feel like its not worth it by the time you get it.

Its 6400 souls, thats very expensive and usually you would want this item after laning phase to snowball other lanes and get picks around the map, but by the time you get it everyone is already grouping up and doing neutral objectives so its active looses a lot of value when for the same price you can buy other more reliable items like phantom strike to be on top of people or maybe use the 6400 to buy warp stone and any 3200 item that fits the situation.

If the item got its numbers nerfed and it got turned into a 3200 item this would be an amazing early to mid item.
